files.caption: Four photographs of 2515 Wildwood Road, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 2515 Wildwood Road reads: The above pictured home is located on Wildwood Rd. just off Nelbar St. Has large living room with fireplace, dining room, large modern kitchen. Open stairway to two large bedrooms and steel tiled bath on second floor. Large basement with recreation room, gas furnace, laundry trays etc. Rear yard enclosed with attractive picket fence, patio and one car garage.
